# Branching Strategy

MobileIntelligence follows the branching model below:

```
main
  ↑
integration
  ↑
development
  ↑
feature/<feature-name>
```

Please ensure:

- Your feature branch was created from **`development`**
- This Pull Request targets the **`development`** branch
- Do **not** open Pull Requests directly to `main`
